email.subject: AI for Vishnick McGovern Milizio, LLP
email.body:
Hi Joseph,

Your firm's recognition as one of the Best Law Firms in America by U.S. News & World Report caught my attention, particularly given the breadth of your practice areas, from Alternative Dispute Resolution to complex Business and Transactional matters. That scale of expertise demands operational precision.

I lead business at Lucio, an AI platform built for law firms that face BigLaw demands with leaner teams. We recently raised $5M, and firms across 9 jurisdictions have chosen us over Harvey because we focus on the realities of smaller practices: precision, client trust, and efficiency.

Having completed successful pilots on the East Coast, we're expanding regionally. I'd be happy to stop by Lake Success to share how, as ex-lawyers ourselves, we're helping firms like yours compete with larger competitors.

Worth 20 minutes?

Vasu
Lucio
